Guide.Title: Manual Activity Query
Guide.UnsupportedDescription: Repository does not have a built-in activity SQL template for this EF Core provider yet. Use the provider's own session, process, or activity catalog views.
Guide.UsageDescription: Run this read-only SQL against the same database used by the selected DbContext when you want to inspect activity outside the dashboard.
Guide.SourceDescription: Repository reads provider activity from {0} and normalizes the rows for the dashboard.
Guide.CopyFailed: Clipboard copy failed. Select the SQL text manually.

PostgreSql.Description: PostgreSQL activity diagnostics read pg_stat_activity, including session runtime, state, client, application, user, lock waiting state, and current query text.
PostgreSql.Source: The Waiting value is derived from PostgreSQL lock wait event metadata.

OpenGauss.Description: openGauss-compatible activity diagnostics read pg_stat_activity, including session runtime, state, client, application, user, waiting state, resource pool, query id, and trace fields when exposed by the provider.
OpenGauss.Source: The query uses openGauss-compatible pg_stat_activity columns and also works for compatible providers that expose the same activity catalog.

Columns.ApplicationName: Application name reported by the client connection.
Columns.Waiting: Whether the session is waiting for a resource or lock.
Columns.Query: Current or most recent SQL text.
Columns.BackendStart: Time when the backend process started.
Columns.XactStart: Time when the current transaction started.
Columns.StateChange: Time when the session state last changed.

Activity.Title: Session activity
Activity.Description: Inspect provider-visible sessions, clients, and current or most recent SQL.
Activity.RetainedSnapshot: Refreshing activity; the previous snapshot remains visible.
Activity.NotLoadedDescription: Refresh the selected context to read its provider activity view. The manual query guide is available separately.
Activity.ReadUnavailableDescription: The provider activity view could not be read. Consult the manual query guide for provider requirements.
Activity.NoCountsOnFailure: No session counts are inferred from an unavailable result.
Activity.VisibleScopeDescription: Every session returned by the provider view, across databases and clients visible to this connection.
Activity.DatabaseScopeDescription: These counts include other clients on this database. Waiting overlaps session states; these are not measurements of this application's connection pool.
Activity.DatabaseScopeUnknownDescription: The database identity is unavailable. The provider-reported summary scope cannot be confirmed here, and these counts do not measure this application's connection pool.
Activity.LedgerDescription: Compare sessions across the full provider result. Open a session to inspect its complete captured evidence.
Activity.SearchPlaceholder: SQL, session ID, database, client, user, application, state or waiting
Activity.QueryAgeDescription: Query age is time since query_start. For an idle session, it is the age of the last query, not time spent executing.
Activity.NoRowsDescription: The provider query completed successfully and returned no visible sessions.
Activity.NoMatchesDescription: The snapshot still contains sessions. Clear the search to restore the full ledger.
Activity.DialogFailed: The activity dialog could not be opened. Try again.

Guide.ScopeDescription: This SQL returns the server-visible sessions exposed to the database login across databases, including other clients and the inspection session. SQL availability describes the built-in template, not the outcome of an activity query.
Guide.RuntimeDescription: Age since query_start, including the last query for an idle session. This is not always active execution time.
Guide.QueryStartDescription: Start time of the current or most recent query.

Inspector.Title: Database session details
Inspector.SnapshotDescription: Inspect the complete query and the normalized evidence returned by the provider.
Inspector.ScopeDescription: This is a server-visible session captured through the selected DbContext. It can belong to another database or client; the selected context establishes query provenance and does not establish ownership of the session or its connection pool.
Inspector.QueryDescription: The provider's current or most recent SQL text, preserved without preview truncation.
Inspector.NoQuery: The provider did not return query text for this session.
Inspector.RuntimeDescription: Age since query start is measured at capture. For idle sessions it can refer to the most recent query rather than active execution time.
Inspector.TimestampDescription: Provider timestamps are shown as received. Their original timezone offset may be unavailable; missing timestamps remain unavailable.
Inspector.CopyFailed: Clipboard copy failed. Select the text manually.

Activity.PostgreSqlWaitNote: PostgreSQL reports lock waits only. No lock wait does not exclude other wait categories.
Activity.PostgreSqlWaitDescription: True only when wait_event_type is Lock. False does not exclude other PostgreSQL wait categories.
